methods_proposed.name: Naive Forecast
methods_proposed.description: Use last observed Production value as forecast

methods_proposed.name: ARIMA
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_arima(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA
    import pandas as pd
    model = ARIMA(train_df[target_col], order=(1,1,0))
    results = model.fit()
    forecast = results.forecast(steps=len(test_df))
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': forecast}, index=test_df.index)

methods_proposed.name: XGBoost with Lags
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_xgboost(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from xgboost import XGBRegressor
    import pandas as pd
    features = ['Area', 'Yield', 'Area_lag1', 'Yield_lag1', 'Production_lag1']
    X_train = train_df[features]
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df[features]
    model = XGBRegressor(n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': model.predict(X_test)}, index=test_df.index)
